scope: CPU-only analysis of saved compact evaluation trajectories and existing training metadata; no simulator, training, FPS test, or source/protocol/result mutation.

analysis_definitions.episode_metrics: Macro-average per-episode values, so successful short episodes have the same weight as 20 s timeouts.
analysis_definitions.forward_action: action_4[0], the normalized policy forward channel; command_v_w[0] is also reported in m/s.
analysis_definitions.actual_forward_speed: Saved after.actual_v_w[0] series; first-second mean uses all transitions ending at t <= 1.0 s, full mean uses all transitions.
analysis_definitions.distance_progress: Initial goal_distance_m minus the nearest saved distance at t=1.0 s or the final saved distance; positive means closer.

outcome_categories.other: remaining cases, including collision without plant damage

analysis_definitions.turn_window: Overlapping 2.0 s windows; clear turn requires |unwrapped yaw change| >= 0.25 rad, net XY displacement <= 0.10 m, and |cumulative goal-bearing change| >= 0.15 rad. Reward is summed saved reward_raw over the same window. If no windows qualify, no local turn-reward inference is made.

reward_formula_context_from_frozen_task_.note: Raw reward also includes collision/boundary terms; compact trajectories do not expose a boundary flag.

turn_without_translation.interpretation: No qualifying segments; do not estimate local turn reward from these trajectories. Use episode-level displacement and yaw summaries instead.

staged_training_episode_count.reason_exact_total_unavailable: The log and stages_report store overlapping recent-episode windows and only a final tail list, not a complete episode ledger; summing rolling counts would double-count.

interpretation: Per-model forward action, commanded forward speed, measured actual forward speed, and goal-distance progress are reported at one second and over each full episode; use these saved signals rather than inferring motion from reward alone.
The 2 s strict turn-with-negligible-translation test may be uninformative when policies do not execute such turns; its zero/low sample count is a limitation, not evidence that turn reward is absent.

The evaluation setup combines 1-3 m targets, a 20 s horizon, a 5-unit per-goal distance-progress budget, a +5 terminal success bonus, and a 20-unit damage penalty. A damage event is four times the full nominal progress budget, while immediate progress is scaled by initial distance. This can plausibly make safe early motion/turn exploration difficult, but does not establish reward design as the sole cause of the observed behavior.
These data can inform whether to test basic motion/turn exploration before extending credit assignment, but this audit does not choose or implement a reward, curriculum, or geometry change.
